C0461.title: Received a 50,000 Yuan Transfer Screenshot but the Money Never Arrived? Multiple Victims Encountered…
C0461.summary: In March 2021, police in Gulou District, Nanjing cracked a fraud case involving fake transfer screenshots. The suspect, surnamed Fang, used photo editing software to fabricate transfer screenshots and gained the trust of multiple auto repair shop owners by claiming delayed processing, defrauding them of over 20,000 yuan.
